title: The Hellinger Conjecture for Antipodal Boolean Functions
summary: The balanced Hellinger conjecture compares the overlap of two output laws induced by a Boolean decision under binary symmetric noise. We prove that a single input coordinate minimizes this overlap among antipodal decisions, whose values reverse when all input signs are reversed, throughout the noise interval. The proof uses a normalized nuclear norm of the cross-class block of the Gram matrix of square-root channel densities.
